accepted.why: The commands are POSIX-shaped with GNU-compatible options, but no Linux run was recorded.

accepted.claim: The carried-by check reads declarations, not their truth
accepted.why: Each named owner was read once by the fresh system half; a later edit to a page or an owner is caught only by the next review.
